blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Marcos administration’s pace of budget releases still lagged at the end of the third quarter, leaving more than P260 billion in allotments yet to be released as the government enters a make-or-break final quarter to accelerate spending and shore up the sluggish economy. Latest data from the Department of Budget and Management (DBM) showed that allotment releases reached 96.2 percent by the end of September, down from 96.7 percent in the same period last year.
